directAnswer.en: This is a site without a stable grid for a pump motor. The 24 mm stone cell is 40 / 120 m. The ≤ 1 inch cell is the longer 100 / 300 m pair. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Diesel Mixer Integrated at diesel 4108 / 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, stone ≤ 1 inch 100 / 300 m, 13 mm stone 60 / 180 m, 24 mm stone 40 / 120 m, 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm and 4200 kg. The series note says 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer. Do not move the same condition onto Diesel 30, which prints diesel 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, 60 m horizontal / 180 m vertical, aggregate 3 cm and below, hopper 0.3 m³, 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm and 2000 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

body.en: Send the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical line you measured, and the supply the printed motor needs.
